{{Quote|Danstrom wasn't even dead yet - the Colicoids pulled him down and started eating.|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Tenn (sergeant)|Tenn]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Danstrom''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] soldier of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during [[3642 BBY]]. While preparing for the assault on the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] at the [[Sundari Flatlands]], Danstrom and his squad were attacked by mutated [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid's]] from a nearby laboratory. Danstrom was eaten alive by the beasts, just as his commanding officer [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Langstrom]].
